profile.reading:
This record points at 4850 East Baseline Road in Mesa, Arizona, under the name Alliance Technology. Nothing establishes that a data centre operates there, and the map history explains how the classification arose.

The OpenStreetMap node was created on 18 August 2020 by a Maricopa County mapper editing in iD over Bing aerial imagery, inside an 86 change edit whose comment reads road updates and building updates. The first version of the node carried two tags only, the business name and telecom=data_center, with no address, no operator, no website and no source note. In October 2021 a second mapper attached the postal address from the Esri USA NAD Addresses layer, which is where the East Baseline Road address in this record comes from, and the original mapper touched the node again in January 2023 without revisiting the classification. So the data centre tag has stood unexamined since the day it was typed, and every later edit improved the address rather than the category.

Alliance Technology is a name shared by many unrelated information technology firms across the United States, which makes independent confirmation hard rather than easy. A domain of that name resolves but sits behind a bot protection layer that refuses automated access, and nothing retrieved this session connects it, or any other company of that name, to this Mesa address. There is no operator website, no business filing, no press coverage and no carrier or interconnection record tying a data centre to 4850 East Baseline Road. East Baseline Road at that point is a suburban commercial corridor of strip retail and small office suites rather than an industrial or utility corridor of the kind that hosts a purpose built facility.

The wider pattern matters for how much weight this row should carry. A query over the Phoenix metropolitan area returns 54 objects tagged telecom=data_center, and 19 of them were last edited by the same mapper who created this one. That set mixes real facilities, such as Iron Mountain Data Centers AZS-1 and an EdgeCore building, with software firms, a web development shop and a legal process server. This row belongs to that group. This registry therefore records it as an unconfirmed business address that carries a data centre tag from a single unreviewed edit, and does not describe it as an operating facility, publish specifications for it, or count it as capacity.

reading.body:
This entry cannot be read as a data center campus because no published specifications exist for it. The address on East Baseline Road in Mesa is tagged in OpenStreetMap as a data center, but reverse geocoding returns only the street address with no business name, and "Alliance Technology" is too generic a name shared by unrelated IT firms across the United States to identify a specific operator or confirm any server infrastructure at this location. No company website, business registration, or news coverage specific to this Mesa address could be found.

Without confirmed operational status or published capacity figures, this facility cannot be assessed for relevance to AI infrastructure scaling. The research record notes that the OpenStreetMap tag itself may be incorrect or outdated, and that web search was exhausted before a definitive operator could be identified.

Arizona publishes capacity figures for only four of its fifty-six mapped data center sites, totaling 512 MW. This entry does not contribute to that published total and should not be ranked among active campuses until operator identity and specifications are confirmed.
